title: EGAS-SLAM: Loop-Closed Gaussian–SDF Submaps for Embedded RGB-D SLAM
description: EGAS-SLAM extends GPS-SLAM with coupled local SDF/Gaussian submaps, lifecycle and residency controls, guarded pose-graph loop correction, tracking containment, reproducible evaluation and native NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor deployment.
